Ivy: Not a drill  we just crossed 101,001,000 requests for the quarter!! :tada: :rocket:
Sam: WHAT. that's bonkers. big love to infra + runtime teams :raised_hands: :sparkles:
Rae: Remote people, unite -- virtual watermelon party? :watermelon: :laughing:

Ivy: pun accepted. tiny poll: watermelon, cookies, or both? react with :watermelon: or :cookie: or both if you are indecisive.

SnackBot: SnackBot: Note - pantry restock scheduled 14:30. Reserving 15:45-16:15 for celebration. No deliveries during that window.
Tom: remote folks, we'll livestream the 10-min photo moment. Rae, can you run a 20-sec confetti GIF overlay so they feel included? :camera_with_flash:

Ivy: shoutout to @runtime for the KV caching and to @eng-sre for the autoscaler tweak. shaves cost and made this possible :clap::sparkles:

Tom: accept but only if someone records me saying "I am the duck" into a 3s clip.
HypeBot: HypeBot: Milestone unlocked badge queued. Automatically posting a team shoutout in #announcements at 16:30.
Ivy: tiny agenda: 15:45 snacks + quick words, 16:00 confetti photo, 16:05 30s award handoff, 16:10 group pic for socials. remote join link in calendar.
Sam: adding guilty-pleasure song: "Ice Ice Baby" (sorry) :notes:
Rae: adding "Barbie Girl" ironically :musical_note:
Tom: i'll bring the disposable camera for retro shots and a ridiculous banana-shaped prop. see you all! :banana:
